[attribute-object-id-type]
=== `@object-id-type` Object Identifier Type (in Related Object)

Type of object identifier (for example, an XML `ID`, a string, the label of the object, a DOI) for a <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of the identifier, for example, “ID” for an XML
                        attribute of type `ID`.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
